items.text: the drafts page lists the chats like the chat list, and a chat opens its drafts as outgoing bubbles, with its own field to write new ones and attach photos and videos.
a draft is edited in place: an editing draft bar sits over the field, the send button saves it, and the send menu can send it and remove the draft or save it as a new one.
a draft can be sent right away or to another chat, without sound, scheduled or deleted after sending, and several drafts can be selected at once.

a long text you erase or replace, a local draft that a cloud draft overwrites and the media you clear from the tray are kept for a week as recently discarded drafts, up to 5 per chat, to restore or keep.
the drafts button by the field opens the drafts of the chat, a long tap edits the latest one.
the title above the chat list is a live template: build, version, time and date, your name, the unread count, the connection status and more, with an editor, a live preview and presets.
items.where: settings → tele → interface → chat list title

items.text: the tele settings follow the desktop pages: interface, chats, messages, sending, notifications, menus, privacy, profiles and ids, bots, debug, server, backup and updates, and the tele row has its own block above telegram premium.
a setting with children folds them under its switch, which counts the enabled ones and keeps their values.
every tele menu can be rearranged: the order, the hidden items, the separators and the submenus, with presets and a text layout to copy and import.
the menu items of a feature stay hidden until the feature is on.
the message menu can copy the text of a service message.
items.where: settings → tele → menus → copy the text of service messages

items.text: the message menu can copy the path of a downloaded file.
items.where: settings → tele → menus → copy the path of a downloaded file

items.text: the TL view of a message opens inside the app.
items.where: settings → tele → menus → view messages as TL

items.text: the menu of a message with an alias can copy or delete the alias.
items.where: settings → tele → profiles and ids → username aliases

items.text: the menu of a sticker set or an emoji pack can copy the id of its owner.
items.where: settings → tele → profiles and ids → copy sticker set owner id

items.text: service messages that you can delete can be selected too.
items.where: settings → tele → messages → select service messages

items.text: tele checks for updates when it starts, not only after the settings are opened.
the test backend checkbox is on the login screen in every build, so an added account can live on the telegram test server.
